claims.speaker: Management
claims.quote: For 2027, we project sales growth between 5% and 7%, representing further acceleration from the growth expected this year, with higher sales.

claims.speaker: Management
claims.quote: For 2027, we are confident that sales growth will continue to accelerate.

claims.speaker: Management
claims.quote: We expect segment operating income will grow faster than sales, with 10-20 basis points of margin expansion beyond the current 2026 guidance midpoint.

claims.speaker: Management
claims.quote: Capital expenditures continue to be projected at 4.5% of sales, as we build out the capacity to support a higher B20-1 value, an individualized Чтоx both an online and offline corporation.

claims.speaker: Management
claims.quote: In total, we expect approximately $2.1 billion in 2027 capex.

claims.speaker: Management
claims.quote: We also expect a 2027 adjusted free cash flow in the range of $3.3 billion to $3.7 billion.

claims.speaker: Management
claims.quote: We expect that growth to come with expanding margins, driven by strong program execution, cost efficiency, growing international sales, and a mixed shift towards more production as our development programs mature.

claims.speaker: Management
claims.quote: Certainly, the strong backlog that we have, the great execution, the placement of our programs in the national defense priorities, all giving us confidence that we're going to be able to execute strongly into 2027 and out beyond into 2028.

claims.speaker: Management
claims.quote: So the low end reflects, frankly, where we are in the budgeting cycle for ourselves.

claims.speaker: Management
claims.quote: And in our fourth quarter call, we'll tighten that range.
